title: التوقف والاسترداد
rule:
Applies when: When a safety boundary fails or an incident occurs.
Contain the affected action, preserve evidence, revoke grants as needed and use an authorized recovery procedure; never hide damage by deleting evidence.
rationale: الاسترداد غير المخول أو حذف الأدلة قد يفاقم حادثاً. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
